subject: E-3122: token rejected on Linux
body:
Good morning. My setup is MeshMail 2.8.8, Fedora 41. Since the weekend, every time I log in, I get 'E-3122: authentication token rejected'.

The clock has been wrong since the battery was replaced. Websites complain about certificates too, so it might be related.

What I tried so far: waiting a day. No luck.

Jonas Berg - Caldera Foods. Appreciate any pointers.
